policy: Metadata and short deterministic summaries only. Preserve each source URL, licence, attribution, and usage note; review source terms before publishing.

sources.name: Hacker News
sources.license: Public API; linked content remains owned by its authors
sources.rateLimit: Use small batches and avoid polling; public Firebase API
sources.notes: Ask HN and Show HN story metadata only. No linked-page scraping.

sources.name: GitHub
sources.license: Repository-specific licenses and GitHub API terms
sources.rateLimit: Unauthenticated REST API limit applies; token is optional and never committed
sources.notes: Only public repository metadata is eligible; inspect each repository license before reuse.

sources.name: Data.gov
sources.license: Dataset-specific; verify the dataset landing page
sources.notes: Catalog metadata is safe to index; dataset contents retain their publisher terms.

sources.name: World Bank
sources.rateLimit: Keep requests low and cache responses
sources.notes: Use indicator metadata and public observations, not bulk scraping.

sources.name: NASA
sources.license: NASA media and data guidance; item-specific restrictions may apply
sources.rateLimit: API key and endpoint-specific limits; DEMO_KEY is for light testing only
sources.notes: A NASA API key may be supplied through an environment variable, never checked in.

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.license: OpenAlex data under its published open-data terms
sources.rateLimit: Use a descriptive User-Agent, bounded page sizes, and cached responses; add mailto only when available
sources.notes: Bibliographic metadata only; do not republish article full text.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.license: ODbL 1.0; attribution and share-alike obligations apply
sources.rateLimit: Overpass/Nominatim usage policies; no bulk or high-volume requests
sources.notes: Requires a reviewed query, caching, and an attribution decision before activation.

sources.name: Wikimedia
sources.attribution: Wikimedia Commons and the individual creator
sources.rateLimit: Use API etiquette, a descriptive User-Agent, and cached requests
sources.notes: Every media item must retain its own license and creator attribution.

sources.name: Reddit
sources.license: Reddit API terms and post/comment author rights
sources.rateLimit: OAuth and current API policy required
sources.notes: Disabled until an application, OAuth flow, and current reuse policy are reviewed.

sources.name: DEV.to
sources.attribution: DEV Community and the article author
sources.rateLimit: Use the documented API and modest page sizes
sources.notes: Metadata and links only; do not copy article bodies.

sources.name: Kaggle
sources.rateLimit: Authentication and current API terms required
sources.notes: Disabled until dataset licensing and authenticated API use are reviewed.

sources.name: Stack Overflow
sources.license: CC BY-SA for user contributions; Stack Exchange API terms
sources.rateLimit: Use API quotas, backoff, and a registered app when appropriate
sources.notes: Questions and tags can suggest problems; do not copy answers into generated stories.

sources.name: EU Open Data
sources.rateLimit: Portal API limits and dataset terms apply
sources.notes: Keep the dataset landing URL and licence for every candidate.
